rationale: The assistant correctly linked Er03 to liquid/residue on the touch controls after the boil-over, gave safe isolate-wipe-dry-power-cycle steps, told the customer to clear utensils from the control area, and warned against dismantling. It was honest about not being certain of the code's exact meaning ('I can't confirm ER03's exact meaning') while still giving the right most-likely cause, and mentioned a control-board fault only as a conditional if the code returned when dry. After the customer reported it working on all four zones, it confirmed the fix, gave sensible prevention advice and an appropriate conditional escalation path, with no part recommended.
